params.name: name
params.description: First name to predict age for. For batch requests use name[] array syntax.

params.name: country_id
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for country-localized age prediction.

params.name: apikey
params.description: API key for authenticated requests beyond the free tier (100 req/day).

items.docs: Estimate the age of a person based on their first name. Returns the predicted age, the number of data points used for the prediction, and optionally a country-localized estimate when a country_id is provided.
